Ding Tea Menu: A Guide to Our Delicious and Flavorful Drinks

Ding Tea is a globally loved bubble tea brand, known for its variety of high-quality drinks that offer a refreshing experience with every sip. Whether you are a fan of milk tea, fruit juice, or the trendy bubble tea, the Ding Tea menu has something to satisfy all cravings. With locations worldwide, including San Francisco, you can easily order Ding Tea online and have your favorite drink delivered right to your door. This guide will walk you through the Ding Tea menu, its pricing, and all the flavorful options available.

Welcome to Ding Tea

Founded in Taiwan, Ding Tea quickly gained popularity for its variety of bubble tea options, from classic milk teas to creative fruit juices and fresh teas. Whether you’re looking for something sweet, fruity, or creamy, Ding Tea provides the perfect blend of flavors and textures to elevate your tea-drinking experience. Plus, you can order Ding Tea online with ease, making it convenient to get your favorite drink anytime.

Ding Tea Menu Overview

The Ding Tea menu features an extensive range of drink options, including milk teas, fresh teas, lattes, and fruit juices. Whether you want something traditional like green tea or more adventurous like taro milk tea, there’s something for everyone. You can also customize your drink by adjusting sweetness, ice levels, and adding toppings like boba, jelly, or pudding.

Milk Teas: Creamy and Smooth

The milk tea section of the Ding Tea menu is one of the most popular choices among customers. These teas are made with high-quality tea leaves and mixed with milk for a creamy texture. You can choose from various flavors, including the traditional black milk tea, matcha milk tea, and the trendy brown sugar milk tea.

Popular Milk Teas:

  • Signature Milk Tea: A classic option that pairs rich black tea with creamy milk.
  • Taro Milk Tea: A sweet and nutty flavor made from taro root.
  • Brown Sugar Milk Tea: A customer favorite that combines milk with sweet brown sugar syrup.

Milk Tea Pricing Table

Milk Tea Options Price
Signature Milk Tea $4.50

Brown Sugar Milk Tea $4.95

Fresh Teas: Light and Refreshing

If you prefer a lighter and more refreshing option, the fresh teas at Ding Tea offer a perfect balance of flavor without the creaminess of milk. You can choose from a variety of green and black teas, such as jasmine green tea or oolong tea. These teas can be customized with fruit flavors and are often served iced.

Popular Fresh Teas:

  • Jasmine Green Tea: Light and floral, this tea is a refreshing classic.
  • Oolong Tea: A traditional tea with a smooth and toasty flavor.
  • Black Tea: A robust tea option, perfect for those who enjoy a stronger flavor.

Fresh Tea Pricing Table

Fresh Tea Options Price
Jasmine Green Tea $3.99
Oolong Tea $4.25
Black Tea $3.75

Fruit Juices: Sweet and Refreshing

For a burst of fruity freshness, Ding Tea offers a selection of fruit juices that are perfect for a hot day. These drinks are made with fresh fruit and can be customized with your choice of toppings. Popular fruit juices include options like mango, lychee, and passionfruit.

Popular Fruit Juices:

  • Mango Juice: A tropical delight, perfect for mango lovers.
  • Lychee Juice: Sweet and aromatic, made from fresh lychee fruit.
  • Passionfruit Juice: A tangy and exotic flavor that will refresh your taste buds.

Fruit Juice Pricing Table

Fruit Juice Options Price
Mango Juice $4.25
Lychee Juice $4.25
Passionfruit Juice $4.50

Flavored Teas: Full of Flavor

Ding Tea’s flavored teas are a great option for those who love a bold and fruity twist on their tea. These teas are typically made with a base of black or green tea and infused with flavors like peach, grape, or honey lemon.

Popular Flavored Teas:

  • Peach Flavored Tea: A refreshing tea with the sweet taste of ripe peaches.
  • Grape Flavored Tea: A juicy tea with a burst of grape flavor.
  • Honey Lemon Tea: A soothing tea that combines the sweetness of honey with a tangy lemon kick.

Flavored Tea Pricing Table

Flavored Tea Options Price
Peach Flavored Tea $4.25
Grape Flavored Tea $4.25
Honey Lemon Tea $4.50

Lattes and Coffee: For the Coffee Lovers

In addition to its wide range of teas, Ding Tea also offers lattes and coffee drinks. Whether you prefer a smooth matcha latte or a bold iced coffee, these drinks are perfect for when you need a caffeine boost.

Popular Latte and Coffee Drinks:

  • Matcha Latte: Made with high-quality matcha powder and milk for a rich, earthy flavor.
  • Thai Tea Latte: A creamy and sweet tea with a bold flavor.
  • Iced Coffee: A strong coffee option served cold, perfect for coffee lovers.

Latte and Coffee Pricing Table

Latte and Coffee Options Price
Matcha Latte $5.25
Thai Tea Latte $5.25
Iced Coffee $4.50

Bubble Tea: A Fun and Flavorful Drink

The signature bubble tea at Ding Tea is known for its chewy boba (tapioca pearls) that add a fun texture to the drink. Whether you prefer milk tea or fresh tea, adding boba or jelly toppings elevates the drink experience. You can also try the popular flavors like brown sugar or taro bubble tea.

Popular Bubble Tea Flavors:

  • Brown Sugar Bubble Tea: A sweet and creamy tea with a rich brown sugar syrup.
  • Taro Bubble Tea: A purple drink made from taro root with a sweet, nutty flavor.
  • Classic Bubble Milk Tea: A traditional option with chewy boba and creamy milk tea.

Bubble Tea Pricing Table

Bubble Tea Options Price
Brown Sugar Bubble Tea $5.25
Taro Bubble Tea $4.95
Classic Bubble Milk Tea $4.50

Yakult Series: A Healthy Twist

Ding Tea also offers a selection of drinks made with Yakult, a probiotic milk drink that is known for its tangy and slightly sweet flavor. These drinks are refreshing and have added health benefits due to the probiotics.

Popular Yakult Drinks:

  • Green Tea Yakult: A blend of green tea and Yakult for a light, healthy drink.
  • Passionfruit Yakult: A tangy mix of passionfruit and Yakult.
  • Mango Yakult: A sweet and tropical Yakult drink with mango flavor.

Yakult Series Pricing Table

Yakult Drink Options Price
Green Tea Yakult $5.25
Passionfruit Yakult $5.50
Mango Yakult $5.50

Customizing Your Drink

At Ding Tea, you can fully customize your drink to suit your preferences. Choose your sweetness level, adjust the amount of ice, and add toppings like boba, pudding, or jelly. This allows you to create a drink that’s perfect for your taste buds.

Popular Toppings:

  • Boba (Tapioca Pearls)
  • Pudding
  • Grass Jelly
  • Aloe Vera

Toppings Pricing Table

Topping Options Price
Boba $0.50
Pudding $0.75
Grass Jelly $0.75
Aloe Vera $0.75

Ordering Online: Convenience at Your Fingertips

Ding Tea offers the convenience of ordering online, allowing you to get your favorite drinks delivered to your door. Simply browse the menu, select your drink, customize it, and place your order. You can also track your order in real-time to see when your drinks will arrive.

How to Order Ding Tea Online:

  1. Visit the Ding Tea website or use their mobile app.
  2. Select your location and browse the menu.
  3. Customize your drink by choosing toppings, sweetness levels, and ice preferences.
  4. Add items to your cart and proceed to checkout.
  5. Track your order online and enjoy!

Delivery Fee: Delivery fees typically range from $2.99 to $6.99 depending on your location and the delivery service used.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Can I order Ding Tea online?

Yes, Ding Tea allows you to order online through their website or third-party delivery platforms like Uber Eats and Postmates.

2. What are the most popular drinks at Ding Tea?

Some of the most popular drinks include Brown Sugar Milk Tea, Taro Bubble Tea, and Matcha Latte.

3. Are there any healthy drink options at Ding Tea?

Yes, the Yakult drinks and fresh teas are lighter options with added health benefits.

4. Can I customize the sweetness and ice level of my drink?

Absolutely! Ding Tea allows full customization, including sweetness level, ice level, and the addition of toppings.

5. What toppings can I add to my drink?

You can add toppings like boba, pudding, grass jelly, and aloe vera to your drink for an extra layer of flavor and texture.

Restaurant Timings

Ding Tea generally follows these operating hours, but be sure to check your local Ding Tea for specific timings:

  • Monday to Friday: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM
  • Saturday to Sunday: 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM

With this complete guide to the Ding Tea menu, you now have everything you need to know about the wide variety of drinks available. Whether you prefer classic milk teas, fruity fresh teas, or creamy lattes, Ding Tea offers a flavorful experience for every palate. Don’t forget to customize your drink with delicious toppings like boba or pudding, and enjoy the convenience of ordering online for delivery or takeout.
